purpose: Pragmatic desktop QA of all39 selected current Go-rendered synthetic fixtures in EN light and RO dark (78 total), exported by current ordinary Renderer.
coverage: Fixed desktop viewport1280x900 only, exactly39 selected templates x EN/RO with both closed-details and open-details whole-document Axe WCAG2A/AA+2.1AA.
Original exported HTML length/SHA/header checks and nonce policy preserved; same-origin exact existing static bytes are hash-recorded and checked unchanged after run.
Person-card fragment has an explicitly declared standalone plain main host with base/trust CSS and language/theme attributes; original fragment identity is retained. This host is not a product page.
Keyboard activation/focus of summary controls, native required-field rejection and POST CSRF/control inventories; no submit dispatched to a backend.
Capture JavaScript/page/console/CSP errors and horizontal overflow; compact Axe nodes and viewport screenshots per state/mode. Save after every state and continue to reveal all failures.
network_and_privacy: Only localhost GET fixture/asset requests reach the owned server. Browser routing aborts all non-GET requests before network and all external HTTP(S); WebSocket handshakes intercepted and closed. No form submitted, no geolocation grant or location call.

Finite GET stubs only: healthz, empty place results, empty graph, empty messaging key metadata/conversations/guardian conversations. Unknown local paths fail. External map tile/style attempts are blocked and explicitly unexercised; unknown external origins fail.

Messaging script may generate a fresh synthetic key in the isolated browser; its automatic enrollment POST is blocked before network and reported. No private keys/request bodies are captured. Persistent owned browser profile is removed in finally; E2EE connection/key persistence/conversation functionality is not qualified.
Service workers blocked; no offline/PWA claim. Only this run’s fresh owned profile is deleted; sources, exports and result/screenshots retained.
scope_limits: Source-only author packet. No Node/parser/formatter/browser/Go/test/PG or candidate execution by the author; Root must independently review/admit before running.
Renderer fixtures are not registered GET/authentication/account/domain/action/provider/production evidence. Current registered transport/backend tests remain separately required.

Axe incomplete results require review just like violations. PASS_DESKTOP_SCOPE is scoped to the recorded fixtures and intentional network limits; it does not accept app milestones or production release.
review_delta: Assert details.open changed after keyboard Enter, besides focus visibility.
Attempt browser close, owned profile removal and server shutdown independently; cleanup failures recorded and final result save always attempted.
Host only the exact exported synthetic person image URI with literal local SVG/hash/type; no wildcard media routing or actual media/authorization qualification.
